Resolves #19190

A node that the diff moves into a freshly inserted subtree now lands at its DOM index.

`Helper#insertNode` leaves moved nodes out of the inserted markup and follows up with one `moveNode` per node. It pushed the logical child index. `DeltaUpdates#moveNode` inserts before `childNodes[index]`, and a text child renders as three DOM nodes, so a node placed after a text child landed inside that text's comment wrapper. The moved-node loop now translates the index through `getPhysicalIndex`, as the standalone `Helper#moveNode` already does.

Evidence: L2 (unit red-first + headless film probe) → L2 required (no close-target AC needs a headed or deployed run).

agent-preflight: not hosted here; the CI baseline jobs ran.

## Test Evidence
Headless film probe, a local and uncommitted read of each window every 100 ms, run with `-g 'under autoGates'`.

**Before**, at the tear-out:
```
delta {"action":"moveNode","id":"neo-dock-stack-handle-metrics","index":1,"parentId":<label>}
DOM   <!-- neo-vtext-2 --><span …>⠿</span>Metrics<!-- /neo-vtext -->   (reads "⠿Metrics")
```

**After**, with this fix and #19189's fix both applied:
```
delta {"action":"moveNode","id":"neo-dock-stack-handle-metrics","index":3,"parentId":<label>}
DOM   <!-- neo-vtext-2 -->Metrics<!-- /neo-vtext --><span …>⠿</span>   (reads "Metrics⠿"; after the compose "Metrics")
```

Mutation check: the after-text case fails without the `Helper.mjs` change.
